name: portfoliohub
description: PortfolioHub multi-tenant file collaboration and delivery platform

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@portfoliohub/api && npm run build --workspace=@portfoliohub/web && npm run build --workspace=@portfoliohub/admin
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@portfoliohub/api && npm run test --workspace=@portfoliohub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@portfoliohub/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@portfoliohub/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=@portfoliohub/admin
scripts.quality: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.quality:ci: biome ci . && prettier --check "apps/{web,admin}/src/**/*.{html,scss}" && npm run typecheck && npm test
